summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end verification of ISNAD i18n migration, insufficient-funds enforcement, terms modal, support center rewrite, admin staff/documents/settings compensation, and full backend regression. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (28 tests: 27 passed, 1 skipped — no available published request for worker to apply to). Frontend Playwright validated all requested flows on preview URL.

minor.issue: OTP is per-phone singleton in storage; concurrent xdist workers verifying same phone can race (fix in test file by retry loop). Pre-existing; not iteration-4 code. test_isnad_backend.py::test_notifications still shows this occasional race under -n 2.

issues: Date field uses native <input type="date"> (`mm/dd/yyyy` placeholder visible) instead of a shadcn/ui Calendar/DatePicker — inconsistent with the rest of the design system and awkward under RTL. Same finding as prior iterations; still not addressed.

Only 4 cards expose data-testid="stat-*" (gmv, commission, businesses, workers) and only 2 of them (stat-businesses, stat-workers) are actual <a> Link elements. The remaining tiles rendered on the page (open tickets=13, open cases=0, pending documents=0, pending withdrawals=0, no_shows=0, active requests=26) are visual cards without stat- testids — review request mentioned 'AdminDashboard has 6 clickable cards incl open cases & pending documents' so main agent should double-check that those lower tiles are wrapped in <Link> and expose testids for QA/analytics.

action_items: (Design) Replace native <input type="date"> in RequestNew.jsx step 3 with shadcn Calendar/Popover — matches design system and RTL better.

(QA testability) Add data-testid="stat-*" and wrap remaining AdminDashboard tiles (tickets/cases/documents/withdrawals/no_shows/requests) in <Link> so all 6+ cards are clickable and testable, per review-request spec.

(Backend robustness, low priority) Make OTP send idempotent per (phone, code) or scope by session_id so parallel test workers don't invalidate each other's OTP (not a production bug, but improves CI stability).
critical_code_review_comments: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS handling: routers/business.py raises 400 with structured detail {code, required, available}, and RequestNew.jsx step 4 correctly parses detail.code and shows data-testid='insufficient-funds-alert' with amounts + top-up link — verified end-to-end (200,000 required vs 19,840 available). Clean.

Terms enforcement: worker.py rejects respond/apply without terms:true (400); WorkerOpportunities.jsx opens data-testid='terms-modal' with disabled confirm until checkbox ticked — verified. Also correctly sets terms_accepted_at server-side.

Support: common.py tickets support category/priority/escalation with activity log; admin can reply → in_review, escalate operations/account_manager, resolve. Non-admin escalate correctly blocked by require_staff('tickets').
Staff RBAC: staff without 'settings' permission gets 403 on /api/admin/settings and /api/admin/staff — verified via newly-created +966500000901 staff token.
Settings compensation: no_work_compensation_pct patch validates 0-100 and persists; admin.py:436 defaults to 100 when unset. Good.
OTP is unconditionally returned in send-otp response — acceptable for demo per prior iterations (would need to be removed for production).
No rate limiting on /api/auth/otp/* — carried over from prior iterations.

success_rate.backend: 96% (27/28 passed, 1 skipped — no available request for worker's apply-terms test)
